answer: A market hiring agents to map basalt cliffs and violet habitats could ration earning permits through vetted sponsors. A public vault stores each sponsor's fixed quota and signed allocations to agent keys. Validators reject excess allocations and debit a permit before transferring it, so splitting among aliases creates no extra capacity. Another earning identity needs additional independent sponsorship, costing persuasion or bribes even in parallel farms. This assumes honest sponsor selection and exact quota accounting; colluding sponsors weaken it, and newcomers need accessible sponsors.
